name: cortex
description: Relative Cortex orchestration for reliable staged agent work with durable internal audit state.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate staged work across Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Adds 21 bundled agent profiles, 10 skills, three coordinator lifecycle operations, scoped immutable dispatch briefings, and worker question/report transport over the canonical local Cortex v8 ledger. Cortex preserves the exact user-authored request, binds native workers for compaction-safe recovery, requires observable task and microtask contracts, reconciles worker claims with per-attempt file evidence, and keeps receipt-backed gates, verification, maintenance, and handoff state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex. Use help, harvest, harvest-refresh, or prune when that exact route is requested.
